implementation: Separate scalar targets, context189 and finite-pair risk/log1p-margin; Torch float64 margin-adjusted CE/autograd/full Hessian on all2598 rows. Runtime uses original valid candidates and unadjusted scores.
CE_definition: CE is margin-adjusted training CE. unadjusted_CE omits margins; both are calculated for both old/new weights. No comparison between different objective definitions.
comparison: Immediately preceding context189 and current weights on identical targets/context and the same new margins. Old checkpoint certificate is checked against its original zero-margin objective only. TRAIN-only description, no tuning or model selection.
caveat: Reference-safe training targets do not enforce reference-safe inference. Violation rates are measured from unrestricted original-valid runtime choices; no runtime GT mask is used.
